verdict.rationale: Ramp has native travel booking with viewable trip details (ramp-docs-51) and automatic receipt capture and memo filling on card swipe (ramp-docs-8, ramp-docs-32). The CLI's transactions resource includes a 'trips' subcommand, which suggests transactions can be grouped by trip. However, nothing explicitly states that bookings, card charges and receipts are automatically consolidated into one itinerary-linked report. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic trip-level grouping of bookings, card spend and receipts into a single itinerary-linked report; detail on how out-of-booking card spend links to a trip; independent or hands-on corroboration.
